Definition
[Compact embedding] 1. ch5:5.7-def-1\group Compactness Let $X$ and $Y$ be Banach spaces, $X \subset Y$. We say that $X$ is compactly embedded in $Y$, written \[ X \CC Y, \] provided

  • $\| x\| _Y \le C\| x\| _X$ ($x \in X$) for some constant $C$,

and

(ii) each bounded sequence in $X$ is precompact in $Y$.
